image_description: A low-angle shot of a weathered street sign assembly against a clear blue sky. The signs are mounted on a thick, textured concrete or wooden pole. There are two main rectangular signs crossing each other: one is reddish-brown with white text, and the other is dark brown/black with white text. A smaller green sticker or label is affixed to the lower sign. The text on the signs appears to be gibberish or heavily distorted, resembling AI-generated artifacts rather than legible language.

The mounting mechanism is vague. The way the signs attach to the pole lacks clear mechanical logic; brackets seem to merge into the pole or signs without distinct boundaries.
Slight warping along the edges of the lower sign suggests minor geometric instability, though less severe than the text issues.
